name: venv extras
description: Makes extra Python packages (e.g. pytest, ipython) importable in matching virtualenvs without installing them there: they live in an overlay that a sitecustomize appends to sys.path. Survives venvs being recreated.

packages.description: Space-separated requirement specifiers, e.g. "pytest pytest-django ipython"

venvs.description: Space-separated glob(s) matched against a venv's sys.prefix

interpreter.description: Base interpreter the venvs are created from (name on PATH or absolute path)
